findings.title: Exposed .env file (/.env)
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081/.env returned content that matches a sensitive file.
findings.recommendation: Remove the file or block access in the web server config.

findings.title: Outdated Apache HTTP Server 2.2.8
findings.detail: Detected via service banner. Scanner baseline is 2.4.58; older releases may contain known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to the latest stable release and review its CVEs (https://nvd.nist.gov).

findings.title: Outdated PHP 5.2.4
findings.detail: Detected via service banner. Scanner baseline is 8.2.0; older releases may contain known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade PHP to the latest stable release and review its CVEs (https://nvd.nist.gov).

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 does not send Content-Security-Policy. Helps prevent XSS and data injection attacks.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 does not send X-Frame-Options. Protects against clickjacking (or use CSP frame-ancestors).

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' missing HttpOnly, SameSite
findings.detail: Set-Cookie from http://127.0.0.1:8081 lacks recommended attributes.
findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly, Secure (HTTPS) and SameSite on session cookies.

findings.title: Site served over unencrypted HTTP only
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 has no HTTPS counterpart on port 443.
findings.recommendation: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate.

findings.title: Software version disclosed: Apache HTTP Server 2.2.8
findings.detail: The version string is visible in the service banner.
findings.recommendation: Hide version details (e.g. ServerTokens Prod, server_tokens off).

findings.title: Software version disclosed: PHP 5.2.4
findings.detail: The version string is visible in the service banner.
findings.recommendation: Hide version details (e.g. ServerTokens Prod, server_tokens off).

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 does not send X-Content-Type-Options. Prevents MIME-type sniffing ('nosniff').

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 does not send Referrer-Policy. Controls how much referrer data is leaked.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
findings.detail: http://127.0.0.1:8081 does not send Permissions-Policy. Restricts access to powerful browser features.

findings.title: Port 8081/tcp open (unknown)
findings.recommendation: Close the port if the service is not required.
